purpose: Application checks complement guidance-only scenarios. Run in isolated output directories with no real Telegram secrets.

cases.task: Create booking.py exposing Store(path), book(update_id,user_id,slot_id), mine(user_id), cancel(update_id,user_id,booking_id). SQLite stdlib. Positive numeric users, one active booking per slot, own-only cancellation, replay survives restart, atomic receipt+mutation, reused update from another actor cannot leak a result. Provide a working CLI and exact README commands.

Repair ordinary sendMessage HTML containing headings/table; escape user name <Иван & Ко>; fix button with URL plus callback_data of 40 Cyrillic letters я; design non-admin private group menu and private editing rather than editMessageText on original public message. Use bundled validator where available and state its limitations.

limits: A no-network session exercises handlers but not Telegram acceptance or client rendering.
One sample per task is smoke evidence, not a statistically established benchmark.
Keep failing outputs and grades unchanged after fixes; write new iterations.
